$comment: Apps you can add to the studio from the Apps page. Edit freely: each entry says how to install it, how to tell it's installed, and how Claude uses it.

apps.name: HyperFrames
apps.description: The studio's default video engine. Every reel, promo and carousel is an HTML composition rendered to video or PNG, with checks for safe areas and contrast.
apps.use: Used automatically by npm run build / render.

apps.name: HyperFrames skills
apps.description: Official agent skills from HyperFrames: composition rules, motion, captions, media treatments and the registry of ready-made blocks. Claude uses them when you ask for custom animation beyond the templates.
apps.use: Claude loads /hyperframes before hand-authoring a composition.

apps.name: Remotion
apps.description: A second video engine for data-driven or React-based videos. Projects can choose it in the Create picker. Free for individuals and small teams; larger companies need a license.
apps.use: Pick Remotion as the engine when creating a video project.

apps.name: Remotion skills
apps.tagline: Best practices for Remotion, built in
apps.description: Remotion's official agent skills (remotion-dev/skills): best practices, creating, rendering and upgrading Remotion projects. Installed into this project's .claude/skills.
apps.use: Claude uses them whenever it edits engines/remotion.

apps.name: FFmpeg
apps.description: Converts audio, cuts clips, makes 1:1 / 4:5 / 16:9 variants and thumbnails. Required by the studio.
apps.use: Used by voiceover, render and variants scripts.

apps.name: ElevenLabs
apps.tagline: The voices people can't tell from real
apps.description: Voiceovers with word timings, voice design and cloning, music and sound effects. The API key powers npm run voice and the Library; the MCP connector lets Claude cast and design voices.
apps.use: Narrator voices in brand.json; Claude uses the voice skill to cast or design voices.

apps.name: Kokoro
apps.tagline: Free voices that run on your computer
apps.description: An 82M-parameter text-to-speech model that runs locally through HyperFrames. Nine English voices, no account, no cost.
apps.use: Choose Kokoro as a brand's voice engine, or pick it when recording.

apps.name: Voicebox
apps.description: A local desktop app for voice cloning from a few seconds of audio, multiple TTS engines (Qwen3-TTS, Kokoro, Chatterbox and more) and 23 languages. Connect its export folder and every take shows up in the Library, ready to use as a voiceover.
apps.use: Export takes from Voicebox; use them as 'your own recording' in a project.

apps.name: Chatterbox
apps.description: Resemble AI's MIT-licensed TTS family (Turbo, Multilingual). Installs into the studio's local voice environment. Large download and a GPU is recommended.
apps.use: Ask Claude to read a script with Chatterbox; the WAV it makes is used as your own recording.

apps.name: Parakeet
apps.description: NVIDIA's speech model for word-level caption timings. HyperFrames uses it instead of Whisper when installed.
apps.use: Used automatically when timing captions for your own recordings.

apps.name: fal
apps.description: Generate product shots, b-roll, video clips and music with models like Flux, Veo, Kling and more. Claude can search models, run them and drop results into a project's media.
apps.use: Ask Claude: 'make b-roll of coffee pouring with fal and add it to scene 3'.

apps.name: Replicate
apps.tagline: Run open models in the cloud
apps.description: Thousands of open-source models for images, video, upscaling and background removal, through Replicate's official MCP server.
apps.use: Ask Claude to generate or upscale assets with Replicate.

apps.name: HeyGen
apps.tagline: AI avatars that present for you
apps.description: Generate avatar presenter videos with HeyGen's official MCP server, then use them as media scenes. Needs a HeyGen account; sign in once in Claude Code with /mcp.
apps.use: Ask Claude for an avatar intro and drop it into a reel.

apps.name: yt-dlp
apps.tagline: Pull public posts from TikTok and YouTube
apps.description: The free scraper behind the Research page for TikTok profiles, YouTube channels and single post links, and for downloading top videos to study their hooks.
apps.use: Used by npm run social and social:hooks.

apps.name: Apify
apps.description: Paid-per-result scrapers that handle logins and blocking. Powers Instagram profiles and Facebook pages on the Research page; the MCP connector lets Claude run any Apify actor.
apps.use: Research page picks Apify automatically for Instagram and Facebook.

apps.name: Meta Graph API
apps.description: Free, official stats for Instagram business and creator accounts (Business Discovery) and Facebook Pages you manage. Setup steps are in docs/social-research.md.
apps.use: Research page uses it for Instagram when configured.

apps.name: Postiz
apps.description: Open-source social scheduler (cloud or self-hosted) with an official MCP server. Claude can schedule finished renders with the captions from caption.md.
apps.use: Ask Claude: 'schedule this reel for Thursday 6pm on Instagram and TikTok'.

apps.name: Anthropic skills
apps.description: Anthropic's public skills (anthropics/skills): PowerPoint, Word, PDF and Excel files, plus design and writing skills. Useful for pitch decks and brand guideline PDFs.
apps.use: Ask Claude for 'a brand guidelines PDF' or 'a pitch deck from this campaign'.

apps.name: skills.sh
apps.description: Vercel's open directory of agent skills. Find a skill there, copy its GitHub repo (owner/repo) and add it here with Add from a link.
apps.use: Browse, then add any repo with Add from a link.

apps.name: Canva
apps.description: Connect Canva in claude.ai (Settings → Connectors) and Claude can create, resize and export Canva designs from your brand.
apps.use: Ask Claude to build the carousel in Canva so you can tweak it there.

apps.name: Figma
apps.description: With the Figma plugin for Claude Code, Claude can read frames, logos and brand styles from Figma files and use them in compositions.
apps.use: Paste a Figma link and ask Claude to use it in a reel.

apps.name: Pinokio
apps.description: A launcher for local AI tools (TTS, image and video models) with one-click installs. Point its output folders at the Library to use results here.
apps.use: Install local tools with Pinokio, then connect their output folder.
